about: Non-Learn planning facts for the ESS planner. The authoritative scenario list, priority order, and dependency edges live in the vendored ESS scenario catalogue (scripts/planner/scenario_catalogue.md). This file holds only the machine-checkable scenario dependency edges (mirrored from that catalogue, applied when both scenarios are in scope) that the check-deps CLI enforces, plus a small recognition lexicon used to spot role/output nouns when reading Learn pages. Each entry carries an explicit source. Do not invent edges the catalogue does not define; re-sync when the catalogue changes.

scenarioDependencies.rationale: Knowledge is the deflection foundation - Ticketing works best after Knowledge; skipping Knowledge means more tickets are created instead of deflected.
Knowledge is the deflection foundation - IT Ticketing works best after IT Knowledge.
Enable a category's reads before its writes (HR Profile Read before HR Profile Write) - governance / least privilege.

recognition.about: Vocabulary the planner uses to RECOGNISE roles/outputs while reading Learn pages. It does not define the roles/outputs - those are read from the page. Extend conservatively.
